name: Signature Metal Works
old_description: Contemporary folded wrought iron straight stairs in Logan Square
about:
Signature Metal Works is based in Arlington Heights, Illinois. The company was founded in 2004 by Peter and his wife Lyuba, building on a family metalworking tradition that spans four generations and over 100 years, originating in Ukraine with Peter’s grandfather Ivan. Peter, a veteran who served in the U.S. Army, immigrated in 1999 and worked on projects including the John Hancock Tower before launching the business with his sons Alex and Ilya.

The shop operates from a 10,000-square-foot facility and handles custom metal fabrication, design, and installation in-house. Capabilities include wrought iron railings, stairs, balconies, gates, staircases, commercial installations, and furniture, with finishes such as powder coating and weather-resistant paint. The team uses both classical and modern techniques to produce one-off pieces from scratch.

Signature Metal Works serves residential and commercial clients within a 50-mile radius of Chicago. Notable projects include railings for the House of Blues and the Aragon Ballroom, entrance work for Giordano’s at Navy Pier, and a remodel for Colectivo Coffee in Wicker Park.

The company emphasizes a “one-stop shop” model, controlling quality from conception to completion, and avoids cookie-cutter solutions by tailoring each project to the client’s space and aesthetic.
